en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude not answering when another Slack app or bot @mentions it; the tag now gets a reply and wakes Claude in a channel it had stopped following after days of inactivity
zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复当其他 Slack 应用或机器人 @提及 Claude 时 Claude 不回复的问题；现在会回复该 tag，并在 Claude 因多日无活动而停止关注的频道中重新唤醒 Claude
